01
Require policy slices at every operational consumer
Threshold authority moves into the policy; mechanisms stay in the CLI. Small injected values exercise representative consumers. The source scan checks a list of retired spellings.
Stated

02
Retire the CLI memory recipe and its tests
The deleted derivation suite has overlapping checks already in the package at base. The consumer now receives those thresholds directly; the two input tables are not identical.
Stated
+

03
Select the deadline by composition purpose
Status observation keeps 100 ms; ordinary exchanges keep 250 ms. Socket tests invert small/large budgets to expose purpose selection; CLI status wiring is a separate source observation.
Stated

04
Give execution reattachment and result fetch separate budgets
The new delivery witness uses the default one-plus-one path and an empty result. Our reproduction succeeds on base and head. Non-default delivery limits are outside this witness; startup retries separately exercise 0 and 2.

05
Keep tiny test knobs in test-only adapters
Adapters build valid policies; they also change fixtures. Forced spill at 0 becomes a threshold crossing, inline 1 becomes 32 in one capture comparison, and records are split to fit the chunk cap.
Stated + unexplained
+

06
Remove a vestigial startup deadline knob
The healthy-startup test stops passing 5 ms, but still checks that readiness waits remain pending for 25 ms. The old field was assigned and never read; missing-owner grace remains a different limit.
Stated

07
Move the mechanism tests with the staged package
37 test files move to package owners while 38 CLI production copies are frozen by a digest. CLI end-to-end tests still use the compatibility graph; they do not demonstrate adoption of DaemonClient.
Stated
+

08
Put a Node-free façade over a dynamically loaded runtime
Declaration compilation and exact API inventories constrain the public boundary. The public execution smoke test disables the daemon; warm behavior is mostly tested through the internal runtime with mocked mechanisms.
Stated
+

09
Make the first routing decision stop later effects
Disabled, absent, starting, incompatible, ready and dead cases assert exact calls and modes. Registry, observation, launch and transport results are supplied by test doubles; a chosen cold route does not wait for warm-up.
Stated
+

10
Own warm capture, controlled outputs and replay decisions
The client allocates fresh temporary captures and returns exact failure text. Tests distinguish retry-safe fallback from uncertain completion, including malformed or missing output; the client harness supplies transport results.
Stated
+

11
Compose lifecycle control and forward a host readiness probe
Internal control tests inspect two timeout compositions and mocked start/status/stop calls. A relocated startup test checks the host’s extra probe argument. The exact composition split has no separate recorded rationale.
Unexplained
+

12
Make registry ownership equality authoritative
Startup decisions delegate to one predicate with narrow coordinate expectations. Tests force the predicate to deny ownership and vary credential/exact-owner fields; no separate reason for this internal design is recorded.
Unexplained
+

13
Name the process coordinator and validate before composing it
WorkspaceDaemon becomes DaemonProcessCoordinator. Invalid coordinates fail before policy is observed; six cyclic callbacks are inert during construction, then each delegates once. Tests specify this arrangement without a recorded why.
Unexplained
+

14
Specify which credentials each request checks first
Execution-family requests check protocol/instance before token; ping/stop remain token-free. Identify and termination use instance/token. The added tests distinguish error order through a direct request harness.
Unexplained
+

15
Own daemon time sources, but scan only one directory
Mechanisms use a daemon wall/monotonic clock. The new test titled “outside daemon mechanisms” scans only sibling files in lifecycle; other package directories are beyond that assertion. This scan scope is unexplained.
Stated + unexplained
+

16
Preserve constructor/acceptance-based idle timing
Idle time still starts at construction and resets on acceptance. A long active request can leave no idle interval after completion. The new test pins that behavior; readiness-armed and completion-based timing are explicitly deferred.
Stated
+

17
Replace the CLI worker fixture and split the version check
The moved worker readiness test uses a generic executor. The CLI version-mismatch check returns as a direct factory test, so it no longer traverses worker startup. Other moved helpers also stop importing CLI composition.
Stated
+

18
Drop seven timing expectations from the readiness witness
The generic replacement retains readiness, file count, exit code and bytes. Three startup-duration and four execution-duration expectations disappear from this case; no specific reason for their removal is recorded.
Unexplained
+

19
Replace the mocked CLI entry checks with built package witnesses
Package process/worker entries execute a generic injected module; launch-path tests mock spawn. The deleted CLI entry test’s exact 257 MiB worker-policy handoff is not asserted by the new built-entry cases.
Stated + unexplained
+

20
Remove the temporary policy-testing export and its lint oracle
The old lint and export tests retire with the policy-testing subpath. Exact manifest and entry inventories now constrain root/process/worker exports; the override factory lives in test helpers.
Stated
+

21
Give Windows exit cleanup a different observer
The built-process test expects Windows to retain the ready record until a caller removes it, without a termination log. POSIX expects child-side cleanup and one log. This local run exercised macOS only.
Unexplained
